Professional, tough and versatile vacuum cleaner. Large capacity, long-reach cable, high-efficiency TriTex filtration system, protective bumper and everything for fast and effective cleaning. Versatile toolkit includes a combi floor tool for optimum cleaning results on carpets and hard floors, crevice tool for hard-to-reach cleaning and dusting tool for delicate surfaces. Packs neatly and tidily away with on-board tool and cable storage.
